
{{alias}}( N, w, strideW, offsetW )
    Initializes a single-precision floating-point workspace array for performing
    a real-valued Fourier transform.

    The workspace array is divided into three sections:

    1. scratch/workspace: the section ranges from indices 0 to N-1 and is used
    while performing transforms. This section is not updated during
    initialization.

    2. twiddle factors: the section ranges from indices N to 2N-1 and stores a
    table of reusable complex exponential constants as cosine/sine pairs.

    3. radix factor table: the section starts at index 2N and stores the
    sequence length `N`, the number of factors into which `N` was decomposed,
    and the individual integer radix factors.

    Any remaining array space remains as unused storage.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N: integer
        Length of the sequence.

    w: Float32Array
        Workspace array.

    strideW: integer
        Stride length for `w`.

    offsetW: integer
        Starting index for `w`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Float32Array
        Workspace array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var N = 8;
    > var w = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float32}}( ( 2*N ) + 34 );
    > var out = {{alias}}( N, w, 1, 0 )
    <Float32Array>
    > var bool = ( out === w )
    true
    > var twiddleFactors = w.slice( N, 2*N )
    <Float32Array>[ ~0.707, ~0.707, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 ]
    > var fview = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( w.buffer, w.byteOffset, w.length );
    > var factors = fview.slice( 2*N, ( 2*N ) + 4 )
    <Uint32Array>[ 8, 2, 2, 4 ]

    See Also
    --------
